richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the front brake lever rocker may have been fitted with components which are significantly out of line. In the worst case this could result in the brake lever becoming seized in the brake applied position thus preventing the front brakes from being released. With the potential for an accident to occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will be fitted with a replacement rocker or the front brake lever.
